init_logger_setup: initialize a distributed logging system with stdout, stderr, and optional file handlers using init_logger
init_logger_with_file: setup logging with a custom log file path and named logger using init_logger
set_root_log_level: set the root logger level to DEBUG, WARNING, or an integer value using set_root_log_level
LogFormatter_format: format log records with rank-aware prefixes, timestamps, and indented multiline messages using LogFormatter
LogFormatter_init: create a LogFormatter instance that captures start time and global rank for distributed job logging
